_comment: Betterstack ClickHouse tables per app for handlers/monitor_betterstack.py. Werewolf's are hard-coded defaults in the handler (BETTERSTACK_CH_TABLE env overrides). Poker's are EMPTY until its source exists: create the source in Betterstack (Telemetry → Sources → Connect source → JavaScript/Node.js), note its table name (shown under the source's settings, e.g. t123456_poker_with_ai_logs), then fill table = "s3Cluster(primary, <name>_s3)" and alt_table = "remote(<name>_logs)" here (or set BETTERSTACK_POKER_CH_TABLE / _ALT_TABLE in the plist). Empty table = the poker scan is a quiet no-op.
